content: cpu/drawterm protocol path (verified 9p.io wiki + Harvey in-tree + 9front drawterm cpu.c): server side is /bin/cpu -R hung off aux/listen via /rc/bin/service/tcp17010 (Harvey ships exactly this: '#!/bin/cpu -R'); drawterm dials tcp!host!ncpu (lib/ndb/common maps tcp=ncpu port=17010), negotiates 'p9 rc4_256 sha1', runs p9any->p9sk1 (or direct mkservertickets fallback), pushssl encrypts, then cpu mounts the drawterm-served 9P namespace on /mnt/term (fversion 64k, mount MCREATE|MREPL), opens /mnt/term/dev/cons as fd0/1/2, execs rc -li with service=cpu; /rc/bin/profile (Harvey sys/src/9k/root/profile lines 9-11) binds /mnt/term/dev/cons,consctl and bind -a /mnt/term/dev /dev giving /dev/draw,/dev/mouse,/dev/kbd,/dev/snarf — rio then runs on the imported draw device. drawterm exports via its own exportfs (exportfs(fd,fd)) serving draw/mouse/kbd(kbdfs)/snarf/cons/cpunote/note. Minimal no-auth-server variant (9p.io wiki 'instant cpu server'): ip/ipconfig; auth/factotum; echo 'key proto=p9sk1 dom=D user=U !password=P' >/mnt/factotum/ctl; aux/listen1 -t tcp!*!ncpu /bin/cpu -R &
